Contract ManageSubjectCRUDService::createSubject(name: String): Boolean {
	precondition:
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		Subject.allInstance()->forAll(o: Subject|o.Name<>name)
	postcondition:
		let newSubject: Subject in
		(newSubject.Name = name and
		Subject.allInstance()->includes(newSubject) and
		newSubject.oclIsNew() and
		result = true)
}
